en.name: Sibyl
en.ability: Each day, after the 1st execution, you may publicly choose a dead player: they may nominate. If the majority of the dead and yourself agree, they are executed.

revisions.v1: Each day, after the 1st execution, you may publicly choose a dead player: they may nominate. If the majority of the dead and yourself agree, they are executed.

en.flavor: To such a degree will I be changed that I will be visible to no one; but I will be recognized by my voice. And with my voice, to you, I give a second chance.

zh.name: 祀命之女
zh.ability: 每个白天，在首次处决发生之后你可以公开选择一名死亡玩家：他可以发起提名。如果你和死亡玩家中的多数玩家同意，被提名的玩家被处决。

revisions.v1: 每个白天，在首次处决发生之后你可以公开选择一名死亡玩家：他可以发起提名。如果你和死亡玩家中的多数玩家同意，被提名的玩家被处决。

zh.flavor: 我如果被改变到这种程度，我将不会被任何人看见；但我会通过我的声音被认出，伴随着我传达给你的声音，我给了你再一次机会。
